title: KCF Semantic-Automation Report v1
description: Triage of still-manual semantic rules (by the kind of effort they need) and automation coverage by semantic risk rather than by rule count.

manualByClass.description: Count of still-manual rules by the kind of effort they need. mechanically-automatable = checkable against today's IR; needs-ir-extension = needs a new authoring/IR field (a grammar RFC); already-enforced/enforced-elsewhere = redundant with another gate; needs-external-facts/human-judgment/advisory as named.

mechanicallyAutomatableBacklog.description: Manual rules classified mechanically-automatable - the prioritized backlog for automating structural checks.

reclassifications.description: Rules whose class was set by per-rule review (automation-triage-overrides.json), with the reason - e.g. which IR field is missing, or which rule already enforces it.

untriaged.description: Manual/profile rules with no manualClass (must be empty).

irExtension.description: Reconciliation of the 89-rule IR-extension ledger against the catalogue's enforcement.
